scientific_integrity: The proof identifies the largest generator prime from the sign of the largest nonzero rational valuation for every prime at least \(5\), then reduces the remaining \(2\)-\(3\) case to a two-variable integer linear system. The finite verifier is regression evidence only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives an exact finite recognition and reconstruction algorithm for rational membership, but no asymptotic count of representable rationals of bounded height.
title: Prime-peeling criterion for rational products of \(1+1/p\)
